verdict.rationale: Formant documents saving a device configuration as a reusable template or exporting it to YAML [formant-docs-46], and says its APIs can configure devices [formant-docs-57]. Together these point toward reusing one configuration across devices, but nothing shows pushing a change to many robots at once. Device groups and tags appear only for analytics [formant-docs-36], which does not transfer to configuration targeting. Missing for 10: documented bulk or simultaneous config push across a fleet, per-group or tag-based targeting of config changes, rollout status or rollback, and independent corroboration.
